description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查询轻量应用服务器的可用地域。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [ListRegions](~~189315~~) to query the available regions for simple application servers.

descriptions.zh: 您可以查询指定地域下轻量应用服务器所有的套餐信息，包括套餐ID、磁盘容量、磁盘类型、套餐价格等。
descriptions.en: You can query all plan information for simple application servers in a specified region, including the plan ID, disk capacity, disk type, and plan price.
